_comment: Remaining entries are Kintone figures DERIVED from the canonical amount (e.g. 10 users x 12 months = P126,000 at P1,050) or UI placeholders. They are arithmetically correct at the current price but are NOT auto-synced, so they must be rechecked whenever data/pricing.json changes. validate-pricing.mjs WARNS on these and FAILS on anything new.

notes.monday-com-pricing: P10,830 is Monday.com's own figure in an adjacent table cell - competitor pricing, false positive
notes.odoo-alternative: P126,000 = 10 users x 12 months at canonical price
notes.odoo-pricing: P378K = 10 users x 36 months at canonical price
